sentences.en: The brain is the center of all curative energy.
sentences.zh: 大脑是所有治疗能量的中心。

sentences.en: The curative properties of this tea have been known for centuries.
sentences.zh: 这种茶的疗愈功效已经为人所知几个世纪了。

sentences.en: This curative treatment has helped many people recover from their illness.
sentences.zh: 这种疗愈治疗帮助了许多人从疾病中恢复过来。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：cura（=cure，治愈）+tive→有疗效的
